nom: PEACH & LILY Peptide Pro Firming Moisturizer

avis.texte: I purchased this moisturizer as my preferred one had gotten too expensive. This works just as good and keeps me moisturized and soft.
My skin looks so much better, has helped with wrinkles, melts into the skin, I have gotten compliments on my skin glowing.
I've been using it for one week, and my skin is getting so many compliments!
Lightweight, absorbs quickly and not sticky. I like this moisturizer because I don't get the milia that I get with heavy moisturizers. This layers great underneath my cerave sunscreen

avis.titre: Sits well under makeup, light moisturizer
avis.texte: This doesn't feel too heavy and has been a perfect moisturizer to move into for Spring and Summer. Make up wears well over it and I feel well hydrated. Probably would not recommend in winter for normal to dry skin.

avis.titre: Really wanted to like it,  but....
avis.texte: Had such high hopes for this moisturizer, however I wouldn't buy it again. Been using it for around a month now, and wanted so much for this to be my go-to, clean ingredients product. It IS very moisturizing, I won't deny them that, and seems to calm any redness I tend to get. But I've been noticing little bumps all over my face, like it's clogging my pores. And I honestly don't see much of a firming effect. I've had better results from multiple other brands in the same price point or cheaper, and that's really why I wouldn't purchase again.

Yes I totally recommend, especially for aging or damaged skin. I keep reordering and reordering this moisturizer because I can tell when I don't use it. My skin feels so hydrated and looks youthful. I hope you come out with a larger size option, like some of the others.

Loving the results of the sample I had to buy a bottle! I've seen a big difference in my skins touch as it is hydrating but light. It has helped with aging lines great formulation. I would definitely recommend, it has now become a grail item in my routine.
This product is light and non greasy. Keeps my face looking smooth and wrinkle free

I use this 2 times a day now as opposed to the Matcha Moisturizer due to this feeling somehow more moisturizing but less clogging to my pores. Also works great with the Copper Firming Serum. Mixes well with Luxe Beam Oil for extra glow - is very light but effective on its own, requiring less than a pea-sized amount to cover entire face. Consistency works great under makeup or under mineral sunscreen (esp. P&L's, but others too). Soaks in quickly. Very little fragrance which disappears quickly. Have been using for over a year and plan to continue.
This moisturizer is light and totally absorbs into your skin leaving it plump and supple.

I got this during ulta's 21 days of beauty. I've been wanting to try it. It's super hydrating. It's a lot thicker than I thought it'd be. So it works perfect for a night cream. It's not sticky or greasy.

avis.titre: This is new go to moisturizer
avis.texte: I went into ULTA in search for a Clinique moisturizer I usually use. Couldn't find it but one of the workers, Joshua, was so helpful and recommended this product. He was so helpful and knowledgeable and had great skin so of course I trusted him. I've only been using it for 3 days and my face is so much softer, supple, and smoother. I've even ditched my eyecream and just use this all over. I have noticably less dryness and less redness overall, and my skin looks more firm than it was before using this product. PLEASE don't ever change the formula. Definitely recommend.
Very nice feeling on the skin. Not sticky ore greasy. My skin feels firmer after use. Not sure of long term results as I have not used it long enough.

I rarely write reviews for skincare because Im so perpetually unimpressed with whatever is currently on the market…. But this stuff is different. This stuff WORKS! My 40 year old skin os glowing! My wrinkles are softened. I don't have any random blemishes. I will be using this as my moisturizer for the foreseeable future!!

I got this during the last sale but will probably repurchase at the normal price. I really like it! Pros - Great for my dry sensitive skin - Moisturizes while not leaving my skin tacky or greasy - Unscented (I don't want fragrance or essential oils on my face) - Did NOT break me out like most other creams!! Cons - I prefer tubes to jars that you have to scoop the product out of - I feel like it's a bit expensive - but the only other product I've used that I liked this much was way more expensive so I will likely repurchase

avis.titre: One of my favorites, customer service always bad
avis.texte: So, buying this, really a great moisturizer, it often says that you get a sample. This time again, so when she was wrapping up what I bought, I asked the Ulta employee at the register it says you get a sample…she's like let me have a look, looked at some printed sheets and she's like, no they ran out. I'm someone who buys there a lot, a diamond member. But the customer service is truly the worst.

avis.titre: Peach & Lily Peptide Pro Firming Moisturizer
avis.texte: The moisturizer smells really good and works quite well. I just started using it a week or so ago and I know I will be buying it again. It is non sticky on your skin, smells yummy a little goes a very long way.
I have tried a million different moisturizers and this is one of my favorites. It leaves my skin hydrated and fine lines smoothed over and feels so luxurious.

avis.titre: Waiting for results  it's been a week.
avis.texte: I like the consistency & how well in absorbs. However I've. It yet seen visible results.

Obsessed with this moisturizer! My skin feels smooth and hydrated day and night. I have tried a lot of different moisturizers but my skin still felt dry and looked dull. The peptide pro firming moisturizer makes my skin feel so soft and gives it a glowing smooth look. It's become a staple in my daily skin routine.

avis.titre: Great for weight loss loose skin
avis.texte: I'm only 31, but have lost a decent amount of weight very quickly. I was noticing some loose skin under my chin/neck area & saw this for half off during the 21 days sale & thought "hmm why not? Might as well try it." Well, it definitely exceeded my expectations! Ive only used it a couple times at night and i already see such an improvement on my neck. I have oily skin so i only put it there and spot treat my 11 lines at night. My skin has transformed almost instantly! Highly recommend!
I use this as the last layering my nighttime routine. It is luxurious without feeling heavy. My skin feels smooth in the morning.

avis.titre: the blue cream that worked wondered
avis.texte: works well. i use this with its blue serum and then apply this blue moisturizer cream here last and it has been making my skin look softer and skin barrier better. loving it.
Very moisturizing, even for aged skin. Have not had it long enough to see long term results, but definitely pleased with this product.
Broke me out in a couple deep under the skin pimples— and i NEVER get pimples like that!! Very painful. Doesnt feel moisturizing enough either. Looked at the reviews and im not the only one.
I love the texture and even color of the cream. I can feel my skin more tighter than before.
First time when I wake up my face still feels dewy and moisturized and I'm over the 50 crowd! Love it
I love this nighttime moisturizer. It has firming qualities, it is full of peptides and has copper peptides especially which has many skin anti-aging properties!

I've been using this for at least 2 years now. It does what it says: hydrates & protects while also firming the skin. I noticed a visible difference immediately. I have combo skin, this doesn't make me oily, or dry me out too quick. Big fan

avis.titre: I have used Peach and Lil
avis.texte: I have used Peach and Lily for years!! I love all of their products!!
pleasant, non-greasy texture that absorbs well and makes my skin feel soft and smooth. I use it as the last layer in my routine - before SPF
This peptide pro firming cream is so silky smooth and glides on very nicely! A little bit goes a long way and leaves my skin feeling intensely hydrated and plump. It's my favorite moisturizer

I alternate between this and Overnight Star and my skin has never looked better!! I also use the Miniprotein Exosome Ampoule and Glass Skin serum and my 49 year old face and neck have been looking and feeling firmer, smoother and definitely more hydrated. I've noticed less lines and wrinkles as well It's a win for me, I adore P&L!! Please never discontinue your products

Absolutely LOVE this moisturizer. I initially got a small sample of it with a separate Peach & Lilly purchase and after one use I knew I had to buy it! It's hydrating and not to heavy at the same time, especially in the winter months. The cream consistency is perfect! I'm 41 and have combo skin that tends to be more dry this time of year and this has been a perfect addition to my skin care routine.

avis.titre: Feels great on my combo skin
avis.texte: This is the first time I've found a moisturizer that doesn't make my skin feel greasy! I'm really happy I took a chance and tried this one. A little goes a long way which is great. I use this on my face and neck. It's only been a couple days of using it but my skin feels great!

avis.titre: So good you don't need much else
avis.texte: I'm 38 with dry skin, living in a dry climate. I've been using a separate retinol serum for my 11 lines & smile lines for a couple of years. After using this cream for a couple of weeks, I ran out of the serum & realized I didn't need to reorder. This peptide cream has my skin looking the best it has in years: healthy, smooth, luminous & blemish-free. It's a definite repurchase & will be part of my essentials from now on, in spite of the price-point being higher than my usual moisturizer - it's that good!

I bought this product on a whim along with their mini protein exosome bioactive serum. I use both and noticed immediate plumpness and glow. My husband asked me within 3 days if I've been doing something different with my skin be are it's so glowy. I used to have extremely oily skin but now being mid 40's and in full menopause it's dry and dull and very finicky. I'm on my second jars of both. It plumps my skin so much and even my 11's look less noticeable.

avis.titre: One of the best moisturizers I've found in awhile!
avis.texte: I have pretty dry skin and I used this moisturizer in the mornings under SPF and makeup. Even on my driest days, it did amazing! It made my skin plump and moisturized without being heavy or greasy. I would definitely buy this again.
I love this Moisturizer/Cream! Highly recommend this! I tried a different one before and it did not work really well and after trying this treatment it was really good!
I like using this product every morning because it light and blends well. It brightens my face and makes me look refreshed.
I love this moisturizer, it sure leaves your skin feeling like you got a facelift, it targets the wrinkles by minimizing them while keeping your face looking bright and hydrated

As soon as the temperatures drop, I reach for this moisturizer. It's creamy and thick enough to battle dryness, but doesn't clog my pores or cause any problems with my oily skin. I notice a significant difference when I use the moisturizer in terms of plumpness, and in overall skin comfort.
I'm a huge fan of Peach & Lily. I use many face products. I started using this cause I noticed a coworker looking youthful. I've already noticed a difference and I've only used it a few weeks.
Does amazing things for my skin, and it looks and feels incredible!

I purchased this item because I am a huge fan of the Pure Peach Retinoic Eye Cream. So far I've been using it for about a month and I love it. It works great as both a day and night moisturizer. My skin is normal (not dry/not oily) and I love that it doesn't feel heavy or leave my skin oily. My skin absorbs the product well and it leaves my skin hydrated and soft. I am loving Peach and Lily products!
Love the Peptide Pro Firming Moisturizer. I get it for myself, my family, and friends.

I really enjoy this product. It feels amazing on the skin. It sinks right the way and it smells good too. I apply it at night. Pairs very well with the MiniProtein Exosome Bioactive Ampole and my retinol

This moisturizer changed my skin almost instantly! I use it at night and go to bed with such hydrated skin. I love all things Peach & Lily, but this product exceeding my expectations. As must-buy for maturing skin.
This has helped my dry skin tremendously so glad I switched product

I'm closer to 40 than 30 with combo skin, cystic acne once a month, and also fine lines - jackpot of bad things. This stuff is amazing. Two months and it's evened my skin out, I don't get volcanos impersonating zits, and I look closer to 30 than 40.

avis.titre: I would continue to use this product.
avis.texte: Nice clean ingredients, fragrance and feel on my skin. Very moisturizing for aging skin without a greasy feel.
Love the light consistency of this product and the great results!

avis.titre: So far i like it, will re
avis.texte: So far i like it, will report back once finished the product. Like that there are no silicones.

I'm going to be 33 soon and this stuff works so good on my skin! It definitely firms and my fine lines smooth out when using this product. I have sensitive skin and this stuff is so gentle on my face. Korean skin care is a game changer!
Loved the creaminess. It is wonderful when paired with a serum, my face feels hydrated but not greasy.

This moisturizer gives me the worst deep cystic acne. Something I've never dealt with. I thought maybe my skin was just changing so I stopped using for about 6 months. The acne went away and I tried again recently, but it gave me the same painful pimples.
Great texture and scent. Works well as a first layer for a smoother, dewier finish.
Love how my skin feels so hydrated, and I love the scent as well.
Good lightweight moisturizer. Not sure of the anti-aging benefits.
This is my first try with this super good moisturiser. Very comfortable on skin , smoothing & firming . I am going to try it further for a full trial & report soon

My skin's appearance looks so much better after I use this moisturizer! I don't need to layer too many products as this has a lightweight yet moisturizing effect. Best for fall weather & spring, and daytime use in the winter. The texture is slightly thicker than a lotion, but not as heavy as a cream.
I love this moisturizer! It's lightweight, takes very little, but does its job. Will definitely buy again.
I love this for gentle exfoliation. I use it a couple times a week. It tingles a little but doesnt cause any issues or peeling.
I really like the peptide products. I feel like they give my skin some tightness and bounce. I use the serum along with this moisturizer nightly.
This is one of my favorites. It's hydrating without being heavy. I have sensitivity to fragrance, so I love that it's fragrance free. Works great with Retinal for All
I love these products but I will no longer order direct. Shipping takes way too long and the occasional discount just isn't worth the hassle.

I absolutely love how luxurious this moisturiser feels. My skin instantly feels plumper and dewier upon lathering some of the product on. I have noticed some fine lines also fading a bit as I've used this moisturiser. I definitely also enjoy how lightweight it feels whilst also feeling deeply moisturising.
I just started using this product and my skin feels hydrated I can tell the difference in firmness, and I have just barely started using it.
Really good moisturizer ! Rich without being greasy, it's perfect for dry skin and/or winter when your skin needs a boost of hydration !

Love this cream! I like to use it along with retinol, and I always wake up with a nice glow. It's a heavier moisturizer than the Matcha one, but that seems to be what my skin prefers most of the time.
This product is wonderful. It's great for dry, moisturizing and firming of my skin and neck!
I love the firming moisturizer! My skin feels clean and soft.

One of my favorite moisturizers! I use this often throughout the week. With a good cleanser, this helps when skin is really congested or overexfoliated. It helps heal any irritation I get in a flash. I also love the color and texture of this cream. Such a beautiful blue hue that feels so smooth is just satisfying to use.
I have very sensitive skin and this does not irritate my skin at all. Makes my face feel so moisturized
I love this moisturizer! It is very hydrating and the cream is easily and quickly absorbed. The shipping is prompt and second to none!
My skin loves this moisturizer! Absorbs into my skin & leaves it feeling softer & smoother. My skin looks more healthy!

I have been using this cream for over a year. It's amazing! The beginnings of lines around my eyes have disappeared with this cream. It's light weight, non greasy, and did not cause any weird skin reactions.
I wanted a lighter moisturizer for the morning and this one was perfect.

This is one of my favorite Peach & Lily products, by far! I use it ever night and love how light, clean, and creamy it feels on my skin. It's so hydrating, that I even wake up to a fresh looking face every morning! And I've noticed my skin looking (and staying) clearer, cleaner, and having smaller pores. I strongly recommend!!
This is my second time getting this moisturizer and is one of my favorite peach and lily moisturizers

This moisturizer is by far my favorite. My face and neck area love the way it feels and it works better than any other moisturizer I've tried for the Colorado dry climate. It has taken a few jars to notice the difference, but I'm loving the results I'm getting.

I have been using this moisturizer for about 2 years now and cannot live without it! I am 64 years old and really trying to keep my skin looking and feeling as healthy as possible. This product is part of my daily routine. It keeps my skin soft, hydrated, and reduces the wrinkles (especially my turkey neck. . . ) considerably. Wonderful product at a super price!
I like tis cream. It is thick but a little goes along way. It spreads nicely and soaks well into the skin.
An essential part of my daily beauty routine. It's firming and hydrating, perfect under makeup. Plus, it absorbs quickly and leaves no greasy residue.
I have been buying for over a year. It hydrates my skin with no greasiness. I have normal skin and am in my 50s and am very happy
Super light yet effective moisturizer especially easy to absorb in the summer months.

I have very dry and VERY sensitive skin. I love this moisturizer at night because it does a great job hydrating while not irritating my skin. This is probably my 5th or 6th repurchase and I will continue to repurchase it! I also used to use the matcha moisturizer but switched to just this one since it's more hydrating. This also smells divine. (The matcha one is also great if you're looking for a lighter moisturizer, but this one isn't even that thick)
Love this! Very moisturizing. Does not cause my skin to breakout, and does offer visible firming results.

Very light and feels nice. Skin feels hydrated after use and a small amount of product goes a long way. Gave it four stars as I haven't been using it too long and I have yet to see a significant difference from my regular face cream.

avis.titre: Love This Moisturizer – Just Ordered Two More
avis.texte: I've been using the Peptide Pro Firming Moisturizer daily and just ordered two more – that's how much I love it! It has a beautiful texture that spreads easily and absorbs perfectly into the skin without leaving any oily residue. My skin always feels soft and refreshed after applying it. I'm not entirely sure how much it's doing for my wrinkles just yet, but honestly, I love the way it makes my skin feel and look.
I have been using the peptide pro firming moisturizer for a few weeks now. I'm feeling like I can tell a difference in my skin since using it. It's very light on the skin and smooths in nicely.

This moisturizer is exquisite. It is light and fluffy and feels silky smooth when applied. It absorbs into the skin and leaves it feeling soft but not greasy. And I have seen noticeable results in the firmness of my skin.

I bought this moisturizer on a whim when ulta had one of it 21 days of beauty®️ sales. I noramlly have combo skin with an oily T zone. Testing it out during the day is too much for the warmer months but just right for colder more dry months. I've had this moisturizer for 2 years and I love it best at nighttime especially over my lips as its not irritating and makes them feel nice and hydrated. I also focus on applying the product over the areas that will get fine lines overtime (not really the T zone since I get oily.) Absolutely will purchase time and time again!
